claim: During an FSx for Windows File Server backup, storage I/O may be suspended briefly, typically for a few seconds; because the VSS service needs to flush any cached writes to disk before resuming I/O, the pause may be longer when the workload has many write operations per second.

evidence.quote: At some point during the backup process, storage I/O may be suspended briefly, typically for a few seconds.

Because the VSS service needs to flush any cached writes to disk before resuming I/O, the duration of the pause may be longer if your workload has a large amount of write operations per second (`DataWriteOperations`).
